name: BOE Technology Group Company Limited
summary: BOE Technology Group Company Limited operates display, Internet of Things (IoT) innovation, sensor, and MLED, smart medicine engineering, and other business in Mainland China and internationally. The Display Business segment designs and manufactures display devices, including TFT-LCD, AMOLED, micro displays, and other intelligent interface devices. Its IoT Innovation Business segment designs integrated manufacturing models for system solutions; smart terminal products, such as tablets, laptops, displays, televisions, low-power consumption, IoT, 3D displays, etc.; and IoT solutions.
